% E2E canonical fixture — math alignment (\eqalign).
% Exercises the display-math alignment leg: \eqalign (built via the \endv
% v-template injection) aligns equations on their relation
% column, so the &=-anchored cell positions byte-compare to MiKTeX within the
% tolerance (+/-0.5pt V / +/-0.1pt H).
%
% \eqalign{x &= y + z\cr a &= b\cr} produces two equation rows aligned on the
% = column; the lhs cells are right-flushed and the rhs cells left-flushed,
% matching plain.tex's \eqalign template \hfil$\displaystyle{##}$&$...$\hfil.
\hsize=6.5in
\vsize=8.9in
\nopagenumbers
\noindent
The system $$\eqalign{x &= y + z\cr a &= b\cr}$$ has a solution.
\par
\bye
